scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities
other_conditions: The SHG must have between 10 and 20 women members.
Only one member per family is allowed in the women’s SHG.
All members must belong to the minority community.
All members must be permanent residents of Karnataka.
Family income of members must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per year.
Members or their family members must not be employees of the State or Central Government.
Members or their family members must not have availed any loan or subsidy from the corporation in the last 5 years, except for the Arivu or foreign education loan schemes.
Members should not be receiving any other support from the corporation.
The SHG must be registered with the Deputy Registrar.
The SHG must hold at least one regular meeting per month.
The SHG must be operational for at least 6 months before qualifying for the subsidy.
The SHG must maintain adequate bookkeeping records.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 50% of the unit cost up to ₹2,00,000, adjusted against the repayment of the loan taken by the SHG.
